subject: Port get_sector_screen associated-sector resolution
description: From b35927626's report: FastFindGrid::get_sector_screen (fast_find_grid.rs:2021) has a doc comment CLAIMING it resolves associated sectors (lifts/drawbridges) but doesn't; C++ GetSectorScreen (RHfastfindgrid.cpp:1876) swaps to GetAssociatedSector() when the hit IsAssociated(), and for a lift overrides both result layer and sector number. Wide blast radius (shared geometry — every screen sector lookup); own task with wide validation. Related: the jump-sector drop-goal fix a891019e6 resolved through patch/jump overlays — RE-CHECK recorder task #3 (mpSelectedSector schema-15 addition) after this merges: the "point inside no sector" cases may now resolve.
